Ibrahim Khan: Hi all / intro — Ibrahim here, joining embeddings infra. Quick first-week access asks so I can run some tiny end-to-end experiments:
- Link billing account `billing-sandbox-2026` to project `redwood-ibrahim-sandbox` (will be low spend, < $20/mo)
- Grant my user `roles/storage.objectViewer` on bucket `redwood-embeddings-dev`, and `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter` on test key `projects/redwood-test/locations/global/keyRings/dev/cryptoKeys/sandbox-kms`
- Add compute region access for europe-north1 and asia-northeast1 (latency testing)
- Request TPU v2 quota +1 in europe-north1 for short experiments
- Need AWS cross-account read-only to acct `555666777888` to inspect VPC flow logs and S3 list on `redwood-checkpoints-sandbox`
Also hitting an Okta device-flow error in gcloud (invalid_grant) when trying to auth — any quick fixes? Who should I tag for billing link + AWS role?

Nora Kim: welcome Ibrahim! For billing link tag @billing-team; but I can start it if you add me to the project IAM. For Okta try re-enrolling MFA or running `gcloud auth login` then `gcloud auth application-default login`.

Ibrahim Khan: Added Nora to project IAM. Re-enrolled MFA; still saw invalid_grant once but then cleared after re-run. Thanks.

Ravi Desai: security/infra notes: if KMS key is under shared keyring we need a short approval. Manager approval required for TPU/A100-like resource requests; for TPU v2 single chip should be fine but please confirm manager. Also prefer time-limited AWS role (72h).

Ibrahim Khan: Manager is Nora Kim. She approves the TPU v2 for short tests. Time-limited AWS role for 72h is fine. Data classification: synthetic/dev prompts only.

billing-bot: Billing link request BILL-1420 created for project `redwood-ibrahim-sandbox`. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/BILL-1420

ops-bot: Ticket OPS-5323 created for IAM, KMS, TPU quota, and AWS cross-account. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/OPS-5323

iam-bot: To apply roles please confirm principal email (user) and whether roles apply to user or a service account. Also note: `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter` will be granted to `sa-ibrahim@redwood-dev.iam.gserviceaccount.com` by default for CI.

Ibrahim Khan: Email is `ibrahim.khan@redwood.com`. Grant storage + compute region viewer to my user and the KMS role to `sa-ibrahim@redwood-dev.iam.gserviceaccount.com`.

Ravi Desai: Security approval requested for using key on dev workloads. Please add justification to OPS-5323: one-line is fine.

Ibrahim Khan: Added justification: "dev experiments for embeddings latency/localization testing; synthetic data only."

iam-bot: Applied `roles/storage.objectViewer` to `ibrahim.khan@redwood.com` at 1934567080. Granted `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter` to `sa-ibrahim@redwood-dev.iam.gserviceaccount.com` at 1934567095. Added compute.regionViewer for europe-north1 and asia-northeast1 to project service account.

ops-bot: TPU quota request submitted to GCP for +1 TPU v2 in europe-north1 at 1934567100. AWS cross-account request filed for account `555666777888` with 72h expiry.

Ibrahim Khan: Verified I can list bucket objects and run a small encrypt/decrypt locally against the KMS key. Okta CLI error fixed after re-enroll; good to go.

sec-bot: Security acknowledged non-sensitive dev workload. Reminder: rotate service account short-lived tokens and do not export keys. Audit will run after temporary AWS role expiry.

ops-bot: Updated OPS-5323 with BILL-1420 and AWS request reference. Keeping thread open until TPU quota and AWS role active.

Ibrahim Khan: Thanks everyone / will ping here if TPU or AWS role not active. Appreciate the quick help!
